judgment_text:
The Order of the Court was delivered by

P.N. Prakash, J.:— When the matter was taken up for hearing, the learned counsel for the petitioner sought permission of this Court to withdraw this criminal revision. She has also made an endorsement to that effect, which reads as follows:

“Since the cheque amount has been paid in this case, it may be dismissed as withdrawn.”

2. In view of the above submission and the endorsement made in the petition, this criminal revision is dismissed as withdrawn.
